name: The St. Regis Dubai, The Palm

address.street: The Palm Island - Jumeirah - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

insider_take: This ultra-luxe beachfront sanctuary on Palm Jumeirah's exclusive West Crescent combines timeless St. Regis elegance with stunning Arabian Gulf views and unparalleled butler service.
whats_special: The St. Regis Dubai is the only St. Regis property in the Middle East, featuring the brand's legendary 24/7 butler service and signature Bloody Mary ritual. The hotel sits on a pristine private beach with panoramic views of Dubai's iconic skyline, including the Burj Al Arab and Atlantis. Its three distinctive towers house just 289 rooms and suites, ensuring an intimate luxury experience. The property also features the region's first St. Regis Bar, serving the brand's original King Cole Bar cocktails in an opulent setting.
pro_tip: Book a suite on the higher floors of the Royal Tower for unobstructed views of both the Dubai Marina skyline and the Arabian Gulf – perfect for watching both sunrise and sunset from your private balcony.
dont_miss: The signature afternoon tea at The Drawing Room overlooking the infinity pool and Arabian Gulf. Take advantage of the complimentary shuttle to The Palm Monorail, connecting you directly to Atlantis and the mainland. Experience the hotel's exclusive beach club with its temperature-controlled infinity pool and private cabanas, plus the world-class Iridium Spa featuring traditional Hammam treatments alongside modern wellness therapies.
pros: Iconic Palm Jumeirah beachfront location with stunning Arabian Gulf views
Signature St. Regis Butler service providing personalized luxury experiences
Multiple award-winning dining venues including celebrity chef restaurants
Expansive private beach with exclusive water sports and beach club amenities
cons: Located on Palm Jumeirah requiring transportation to central Dubai attractions
